id.instruksi: Baca rantai makanannya, lalu sentuh perkiraan yang paling masuk akal.
id.i-makanbanyak: zat bertahan di tubuh pemangsa setelah ia makan mangsa yang sudah tercemar
id.i-airsaja: racun hanya ada di air minumnya
id.i-tanparacun: risiko elang memakan tikus yang keracunan berkurang
id.p-r1: DDT sulit terurai dan tersimpan dalam tubuh. Di rantai padi → belalang → katak → elang, mana yang cenderung memiliki kadar DDT tertinggi?
id.p-r2: DDT menempel di padi lalu pindah melalui rantai padi → belalang → katak → elang. Makhluk hidup mana yang terkena DDT langsung sebelum yang lain memakannya?
id.p-r3: Di danau, metilmerkuri berpindah melalui ganggang → ikan kecil → bangau. Mana yang cenderung memiliki kadar metilmerkuri tertinggi?
id.p-r4: Zat pencemar tertentu bertahan lama di tubuh mangsa. Mengapa kadar zat ini cenderung meningkat pada pemangsa puncak?
id.p-r5: Di jaring sawah, katak memakan belalang. Bila katak mati karena racun, belalang kemungkinan…
id.p-r6: Di kolam ini ular hanya memakan katak. Bila katak mati karena racun, ular kemungkinan…
id.p-r7: Elang memakan tikus di sawah. Petani mengganti racun tikus dengan burung hantu pemangsa tikus. Mengapa elang lebih aman?
id.p-r8: Metilmerkuri berpindah melalui lumut air → ikan → berang-berang. Mana yang cenderung memiliki kadar metilmerkuri terendah?
id.p-r9: Di rantai ganggang → ikan kecil → bangau, metilmerkuri berpindah dari air ke kelompok pertama. Kelompok apa itu?
id.p-r10: Metilmerkuri berpindah melalui lumut air → ikan → berang-berang. Mana yang cenderung memiliki kadar metilmerkuri tertinggi?
id.p-r11: DDT sulit terurai dan tersimpan dalam tubuh. Di rantai padi → belalang → katak → elang, mana yang cenderung memiliki kadar DDT terendah?
id.p-r12: Di sungai ini berang-berang hanya memakan ikan. Bila ikan mati karena racun, berang-berang kemungkinan…
id.p-r13: Di danau ini hanya ikan kecil yang memakan ganggang. Bila ikan kecil mati karena racun, ganggang kemungkinan…

en.instruksi: Read the food chain, then touch the most sensible prediction.
en.i-makanbanyak: the pollutant stays in the predator after it eats contaminated prey
en.i-airsaja: the poison is only in its drinking water
en.i-tanparacun: eagles are less likely to eat poisoned rats
en.i-elangkenyang: eagles no longer need to eat
en.p-r1: DDT breaks down slowly and builds up in living things. In rice → grasshopper → frog → eagle, which tends to have the highest DDT concentration?
en.p-r2: DDT lands on rice and moves through rice → grasshopper → frog → eagle. Which organism is exposed directly before it is eaten?
en.p-r3: In a lake, methylmercury moves through algae → small fish → heron. Which tends to have the highest methylmercury concentration?
en.p-r4: Some pollutants stay in prey for a long time. Why does their concentration tend to rise in top predators?
en.p-r5: In the rice-field web, frogs eat grasshoppers. If the frogs die from poison, the grasshoppers will probably…
en.p-r6: In this pond the snakes eat only frogs. If the frogs die from poison, the snakes will probably…
en.p-r7: Eagles hunt rats in the rice fields. Farmers use barn owls to hunt rats instead of rat poison. Why is this safer for eagles?
en.p-r8: Methylmercury moves through water moss → fish → otter. Which tends to have the lowest methylmercury concentration?
en.p-r9: In algae → small fish → heron, methylmercury moves from the water to the first group. Which group is it?
en.p-r10: Methylmercury moves through water moss → fish → otter. Which tends to have the highest methylmercury concentration?
en.p-r11: DDT breaks down slowly and builds up in living things. In rice → grasshopper → frog → eagle, which tends to have the lowest DDT concentration?
en.p-r12: In this river otters eat only fish. If the fish die from poison, the otters will probably…
en.p-r13: In this lake only small fish eat the algae. If the small fish die from poison, the algae will probably…
